content.campaign_name: Highland Paws: Grain-Free, Made in Small Batches
content.copy: Meet Highland Paws, the small-batch grain-free dog food with single-source chicken and salmon that Bengaluru dogs already come back for. Launching with a 10% introductory price on the Alpine range.

discount_ask.rationale: The vendor funds the full 10% launch discount; we add no platform-funded discount in the first 30 days.
